'''Maravada''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of a civilization which occupied the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaleth]]<ref name="TheChamberofSpeech" /> and the site of the ancient [[Je'daii Order]]'s Temple of Knowledge<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> sometime after the [[Force Wars]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Known as Maravada the Silent, Maravada was a philosopher and a recluse, and dedicated his time to categorizing and naming the elements of the cosmos. His reign was remembered as a time of peace and learning, which contrasted sharply with that of one of his predecessors [[Avamarivash]]. A history of Maravada's reign could be found in the [[Chamber of Speech]] in Kaleth up until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] return to Tython.<ref name="TheChamberofSpeech" />
